{{Quote|What's he run on, peat?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
'''Peat''' was a substance that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] asked [[Jessa Vandangante]], in jest, if [[BLX-5|Bollux]] ran on, after making [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-fall on [[Sarlucif]]. This was a reference to the age of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and its peeling, brown primer finish.
